chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Whoever divorces his wife three times in one sitting, while she is menstruating, it is not valid. And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) rejected the divorce of Abdullah ibn Umar when he divorced his wife three times while she was menstruating, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) invalidated that divorce.
And he (peace be upon him) said: Everything that contradicts the Book of Allah, Exalted and Mighty, is returned to the Book of Allah, Exalted and Mighty.
And he (peace be upon him) said: There is no divorce except during a waiting period.
ai.seo_question: Is triple divorce valid if given while the wife is menstruating?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the Shia juristic consensus that a triple divorce pronounced simultaneously during menstruation is invalid, citing the Prophet’s reversal of Abdullah ibn Umar’s case as a definitive precedent. It reinforces the principle of 'rad' (reversion) to the Quran for any practice contradicting divine text, specifically linking the ruling to the verse 'La talaka illa fi 'iddah' (Divorce is only valid during a period of purity/waiting). This establishes that the three divorces are counted as one in this context, a key distinction in Shia fiqh compared to some Sunni schools.
